hero.title: Scientifically Founded Business Structure and Decision Analysis
hero.tagline: Analytical work based on business theory. For companies with high standards for clarity, structure, and reliable decision-making foundations.
hero.languages: Consulting in German, Ukrainian, and Russian.

forWhom.heading: Who is this consulting for?
forWhom.intro: This consulting is aimed at entrepreneurs:
items: who are under constant decision-making pressure
whose key figures are no longer clearly explainable
whose structure has grown historically and become unclear
who bear responsibility and seek clarity instead of activism
who are ready to make decisions based on structured analysis

whenUseful.heading: When is an analysis useful?
whenUseful.intro: An analysis is particularly useful when:
items: Results stagnate or decline
Decisions consume a lot of energy
Responsibilities have become unclear
Internal processes are no longer transparent
Deviations between planning and reality occur

whatYouGet.heading: What You Get
items: a structured business analysis
a plausibility check of the data basis
clearly formulated decision options
prioritized recommendations for action
transparency about structural weaknesses
whatYouGet.responsibility: The entrepreneurial decision remains exclusively with you.

stage1.title: Structure Consultation
stage1.subtitle: 30 minutes, free
stage1.description: Non-binding conversation to clarify your initial situation and assess the collaboration.
stage1.note: The structure consultation does not include individual detailed analysis or tax/legal case-by-case advice.

stage2.title: Structure & Deviation Analysis
stage2.description: Comprehensive business analysis including evaluation meeting.
stage2.goal: Establish structure, clarify decision logic, and make deviations visible.

stage3.title: Strategic Support
stage3.subtitle: optional
stage3.description: Monthly decision support and monitoring based on the analysis.
stage3.note: No operational implementation and no assumption of entrepreneurial responsibility.

package1.name: Structure Audit
package1.subtitle: Basic Analysis
items: Review of provided documents
Analysis of structure and decision logic
Plausibility check of business data basis
Results meeting (60–90 minutes)
written summary (1–2 pages)

package2.name: In-depth Structure & Function Analysis
package2.subtitle: Extended analysis for noticeable deviations
items: second evaluation loop
structured priority list
roadmap (30–60 days)
additional strategy meeting

legalFramework.heading: Legal Framework
legalFramework.notIncluded: Not part of the service are:
items: Tax advice within the meaning of the Tax Advisory Act (StBerG)
Legal advice within the meaning of the Legal Services Act (RDG)
Creation or assumption of ongoing bookkeeping
Preparation of tax returns or annual financial statements
Representation before authorities or courts
legalFramework.disclaimer: No specific economic success is owed.

liability.heading: Liability Notice
liability.text1: Liability is – except in cases of intent – limited to the coverage amount of the existing professional liability insurance.
liability.text2: No liability is assumed for damages based on incomplete or incorrect information.
